summary: This directory defines the conceptual data structures for analyzing software packages, their internal structure, dependencies, and exported symbols. It provides a standardized schema for representing the results of static analysis performed on packages and their components.
responsibilities: Define interfaces for representing package metadata and configuration
Model the structure of dependencies within a package
Describe the organization of files and directories within a package
Capture structural details and documentation of exported symbols
Map exported symbols to their corresponding source files and paths
relationships: A PackageAnalysis aggregates PackageInfoAnalysis, dependencies, and directory structures to represent a complete project.
PackageExportAnalysis links specific exported symbols to the files they originate from within the package.
ExportedSymbolAnalysis provides the internal details of specific symbols found within a PackageExportAnalysis.
designDecisions: Use of TypeScript interfaces for strongly-typed data representation
Composition of smaller analysis units into a comprehensive package model
Decoupling of structural metadata from physical file storage
